text: A Psalm of David. Jehovah{H3068} is my shepherd;{H7462} I shall not want.{H2637}
He maketh me to lie down{H7257} in green{H1877} pastures;{H4999} He leadeth{H5095} me beside still{H4496} waters.{H4325}
He restoreth{H7725} my soul:{H5315} He guideth{H5148} me in the paths{H4570} of righteousness{H6664} for his name's{H8034} sake.
Yea, thou I walk{H3212} through the valley{H1516} of the shadow of death,{H6757} I will fear{H3372} no evil;{H7451} for thou art with me; Thy rod{H7626} and thy staff,{H4938} they comfort{H5162} me.
Thou preparest{H6186} a table{H7979} before{H6440} me in the presence of mine enemies:{H6887} Thou hast anointed{H1878} my head{H7218} with oil;{H8081} My cup{H3563} runneth over.{H7310}
Surely goodness{H2896} and lovingkindness{H2617} shall follow{H7291} me all the days{H3117} of my life;{H2416} And I shall dwell{H3427} in the house{H1004} of Jehovah{H3068} for ever.{H753}
